sources.entry: Sabaki - An elegant Go/Baduk/Weiqi board and SGF editor for a more civilized age.

summary.one_liner: Sabaki is a Go (Baduk/Weiqi) board and SGF game editor for reviewing, annotating, and analyzing games.
summary.what_it_does: The README lists features rather than build steps. It reads and saves SGF games and collections, and opens wBaduk NGF and Tygem GIB files. It displays SGF comments with a subset of Markdown and lets you annotate board positions and moves, including lines and arrows markup. It supports copy and paste of variations, undo/redo, and a game tree. It includes a score estimator and scoring tool, and can find moves by position or comment text. It works with GTP engines, with board analysis for supported engines, and offers guess mode and autoplay. Board appearance can be customized with textures and themes.
use_cases: Analyzing positions with a GTP engine
Estimating score of a finished game
Practicing move recognition in guess mode
Converting or opening NGF and GIB game records
notable: Opens wBaduk NGF and Tygem GIB files in addition to SGF
GTP engine support with board analysis
Lines and arrows board markup with Markdown-formatted comments
Guess mode and autoplay for games
caveats: README gives no install or build steps; it points to external documentation for building and tests
Analysis features depend on which GTP engines are supported
